newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria to be among first to qualify for EMU.
newsitem.headline: Austria to be among first to qualify for EMU.

text.p: Austria hopes to see as many nations as possible make the start of a single European currency, but it is against watering down the Maastricht criteria, Finance Minister Rudolf Edlinger said on Friday.
Edlinger also told Reuters in an interview he was confident Austria would be among the first group of nations to introduce the single currency.
"I believe it would be good if as many countries as possible were there from the start," Edlinger said. "(But) the criteria should not be softened. The euro should be a strong currency."
He said that given modest economic growth this year, Austria would have no difficulty making the grade.
"If the economy grows at the expected 1.2-1.6 percent this year it is possible to reach the Maastricht goal." -- Vienna Newsroom, 43-1-53112-254
